description: 布达佩斯弃兵 A52 — 黑方也能弃兵！主动弃兵争反击权

intro.popup_en: Gambit Initiative, Lesson 4: The Budapest Gambit shows that Black can offer a pawn too. Black gives up a pawn on move two to challenge White's expanding center and gain counterattacking speed and initiative.
intro.popup:
弃兵争先 第4课

前3课都是白方弃兵——
弃兵永远是白方的特权吗？

不！

布达佩斯弃兵：
黑方第2手就主动送出一个兵！

目的是什么？
和白方一样：
用一个兵换取反击的速度和主动权！

outro.popup_en: Black's gambit aims to prevent White from building an overwhelming center, develop quickly, and create complications before White consolidates. Either side can offer a pawn; what matters is whether the compensation is sufficient. The side that develops first can seize the initiative, while the side that falls behind may come under pressure.
outro.popup:
布达佩斯弃兵总结

黑方弃兵的三个目标：
① 阻止白方建立巨大中心
② 快速出子，争夺发展
③ 在白方稳固之前制造混乱

弃兵争先的普遍原理：
不分颜色——谁都可以弃兵
关键是：弃兵后的补偿够不够？

口诀：先弃先出，后出被压！

moves.popup_en: d4! White opens with the queen's pawn and prepares a broad center.
moves.popup: d4！白方d4首开，准备建立大中心

moves.popup_en: ...Nf6 develops a knight first, following a hypermodern approach.
moves.popup: Nf6 超现代！黑方先发展马

moves.popup_en: c4! White expands again. The d4-c4 pawns are building a large center.
moves.popup:
c4！白方继续扩张！
d4+c4，白方正在建立巨大中心

moves.popup_en: ...e5!! The Budapest Gambit. Black offers the e5-pawn to disrupt White's central plan. This is a strategic sacrifice, not a blunder: should White accept it?
moves.popup:
e5！！布达佩斯弃兵！

黑方主动送出e5兵！

这不是失误——这是战略：
用一个兵破坏白方的中心计划！
白方到底要不要吃？

moves.popup_en: dxe5 accepts the gambit. White wins the e5-pawn, but it is now exposed and may be difficult to defend.
moves.popup:
dxe5 白方接受弃兵

白方吃掉了黑方的e5兵
但现在e5是个"孤悬"的兵——
怎么守？

moves.popup_en: ...Ng4! The knight immediately attacks e5. Black's gambit idea is to develop while attacking the pawn: develop first, then apply pressure.
moves.popup:
Ng4！马立刻攻击e5！

⭐ 黑方弃兵的逻辑：
白方吃了e5，马上就会被攻击！
黑方的每一步都在发展+攻击

这就是弃兵争先：先出，后攻！

moves.popup_en: Nf3 defends the e5-pawn. White has spent a move protecting it while Black continues to develop. White's pawn moves have not brought out as many pieces as Black's developing moves.
moves.popup:
Nf3 白方守护e5兵

白方必须花一步棋守住这个兵
而黑方却在发展！

⭐ 已出子对比：
白方：d4+c4+Nf3（其中两步是走兵）
黑方：Nf6+Ng4（纯发展！）
黑方发展效率更高！

moves.popup_en: ...Bc5! Black develops a second piece and targets f2, bringing more pressure toward White's king.
moves.popup:
Bc5！黑方第二枚子发展！

象瞄准f2，施压白方王翼
黑方的子力已经向中心汇集

moves.popup_en: Bf4! White develops the bishop and protects e5. The move order matters: White should play Bf4 before e3, which would block the bishop's route to f4. One move both develops and defends.
moves.popup:
Bf4！白方象发展，同时守住e5！

⭐ 注意顺序：
必须先走Bf4，再走e3
因为e3兵会挡住象回到f4的路！

白方一步棋：发展+防守，效率极高

moves.popup_en: ...Nc6! Black develops another piece and increases the attack on e5. The knights on c6 and g4 coordinate, leaving White's pawn under serious pressure.
moves.popup:
Nc6！黑方第三枚子！

现在黑方：Nf6+Ng4+Bc5+Nc6
四枚子都在攻击e5！

⭐ 关键配合：
Nc6+Ng4协作，e5岌岌可危！

moves.popup_en: e3 reinforces the center and supports c4. Now it no longer blocks the bishop's route to f4.
moves.popup:
e3 白方稳固中心
守住c4，但注意——此时e3不再挡住象

moves.popup_en: ...Ngxe5! Black recovers the pawn with the knight from g4. In exchange for one pawn, Black developed four pieces, disrupted White's center, and seized the initiative.
moves.popup:
Ngxe5！黑方夺回材料！

Ng4终于吃掉了e5兵！
黑方送出去的兵回来了……

⭐ 总结时刻：
黑方用一个兵，换取了：
① 快速发展4枚子
② 白方中心被破坏
③ 黑方主动，子力活跃

moves.popup_en: Nxe5 captures Black's knight, exchanging a pair of knights.
moves.popup:
Nxe5 白方马吃掉黑马
兑换一对马

moves.popup_en: ...Nxe5 recaptures on e5. The knights have been exchanged and Black has recovered the gambit pawn. White's central expansion has been stopped; the d- and e-pawns are gone and c4 has also been exchanged.
moves.popup:
Nxe5 黑方重新夺回e5

双方已经兑换了马
黑方的弃兵已经"回本"！

⭐ 棋局如今：
白方中心兵d4，c4已不在
e4、d4全部消失！
黑方成功阻止了白方的中心扩张

moves.popup_en: Qd5! White's queen attacks the knight on e5.

...Qe7 defends the knight. The position is balanced, and Black's gambit has achieved its aims: limit White's large center, develop actively, and gain control of the counterattack. A gambit is not only a White weapon.
moves.popup:
Qe7 黑方后出来保护马

局面均衡！黑方的弃兵战术成功：
① 阻止了d4体系的大中心
② 子力活跃、协调
③ 用一个兵赢取了反击控制权

⭐ 弃兵不是白方专利！
